description: The signed-in Lemma workspace runs on a remote origin - the locald-served local app URL, or the hosted site - so it reaches the shell only through this capability. It grants opening Local settings, connecting this computer's Agent Host, and pointing this installation at an AI provider, because those are the surfaces a user meets during onboarding and cannot be sent to another window to complete. Note what is deliberately absent: nothing here can stop the Agent Host or drop a pairing. The workspace can ask this computer to be running, to pair, and to look for agents again - never the reverse, because an automatic connection and a remote off switch would spend their lives undoing each other. It can also read how the sandbox image download is going, which is a read of state the shell already holds and changes nothing. Provider configuration is deliberately the only operator setting here: it reaches config.set-ai, which merges that one section and cannot touch sharing, tunnels, runtime, or diagnostics. Both local workspace hosts are listed because the base domain this install serves under is chosen at runtime: a browser derives no registrable domain from *.localhost, so an install that needs pod apps to work inside the workspace serves itself under a loopback wildcard instead, and the workspace origin moves with it. Shared LAN and public-tunnel origins are different hosts and are deliberately not listed, so a visitor's browser matches nothing.
